opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Warehouse labor, rent, utilities and head office.

follow100Note: Membership fees were only $1.90 of every $100 of revenue, yet they covered about 54% of Costco's operating profit — the membership model, not the markup, is where the money is.
footerNote: Costco's merchandise costs include buying, freight and shrink (lost or damaged goods) — the direct cost of what's on the shelves. The quarter is 12 weeks, ended February 18, 2024.

kpis.label: Comparable sales
kpis.note: total company; +5.8% adjusted for fuel and currency

oneTimers: A $94M tax benefit ($0.21 per diluted share) from the deductibility of the $15-per-share special dividend, to the extent it was received by 401(k) plan participants — it flatters this quarter's profit and lowers its tax rate.
otherDetail: Interest income and other of $216M, less $41M of interest expense.

segments.name: Net sales
segments.note: Everything sold in the warehouses and online — comparable sales rose 5.6%, or 5.8% after adjusting for fuel prices and currency; a shift in the fiscal calendar, after last year's 53rd week, trimmed about 1.5% from reported growth.

segments.name: Membership fees
segments.note: Annual fees from members — almost pure profit, since the warehouses would run anyway.

takeaways.text: Comparable sales rose 5.6% — U.S. +4.3%, Canada +9.2% and other international +8.6% — or 5.8% after adjusting for fuel prices and currency, and e-commerce comparable sales jumped 18.4%.
takeaways.title: Shoppers kept coming

takeaways.text: Membership fees rose 8.2% to $1.11B. They are just 1.9% of revenue, yet they alone cover about 54% of the quarter's $2.06B in operating income. Costco ended the quarter with 875 warehouses, including 603 in the United States and Puerto Rico.
takeaways.title: Membership is the profit engine

takeaways.text: Net income rose to $1.74B ($3.92 per share) from $1.47B a year ago. Operating income itself rose 8.4% to $2.06B, and this year's figure also included a $94M tax benefit linked to the special dividend.
takeaways.title: Profit up 19% with a tax assist

verdict: Costco's net sales rose 5.7% to $57.3B as comparable sales grew 5.6%, and with $1.11B of nearly cost-free membership fees on top, profit rose 19% to $1.74B — helped by a one-off $94M tax benefit tied to the special dividend.
